title: Scope of Article 2 and mixed transactions
shortTitle: Scope of Article 2 and mixed transactions
summary: The governing-law inquiry can change both formation and term-selection analysis.
notes: The text compares a goods sale with installation, a navigation device with continuing services, and the sale of a radio business containing both goods and other assets. Bonebrake uses predominant purpose; Foster separates portions; Anthony Pools looks to the gravamen of the particular claim. The book then reproduces 2022 amendments addressing hybrid transactions and explicitly notes that enactment was at an early stage in April 2023. This update reports that publication-time status and makes no claim about enactment in 2026.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 248–250. Open assigned page 248.
